Community-created OpenStreetMap data as of %s. Learn more about how to edit and update the map at OpenStreetMap.org

OpenStreetMap.org (OSM) is a community project to build a free and open map. It\'s the main source of map data in NoGPS Maps and works similar to Wikipedia. You can add or edit places and they become available to millions of users all over the World.\nJoin the community and help to make a better map for everyone!
Create an OpenStreetMap account or log in to publish your map edits to the world.

The speed corrections learned from GPS at different speeds and from your corrections will be forgotten. Do it after new tyres or another car. They are learned anew while GPS works.
Navigation when GPS is jammed or spoofed
Without GPS the car is driven by the inertial navigation: the turns come from the gyroscope, the distance from the car speed via OBD-II. The car is kept on the roads of the offline map.
